referenceSources.title: Honda Civic hatchback 1992-95 Type A (EG) – JP USA
referenceSources.description:
A 1992–95 Honda Civic hatchback (EG Type A) outfitted with a JP Type-A FRP body kit is captured in action on a racetrack. The complete kit includes a front bumper, left and right side skirts, and a rear bumper, all finished in white gel-coat. Bold red and blue 5ZIGEN USA graphics dominate the side profile, while additional sponsor decals—HONDATA, PIAA, Endless, Toyo Tires, HKS, NGK, AEM, NASA, and ASR—accent the car’s racing livery.

The race-prepped Civic features white multi-spoke wheels, a rear spoiler, and an interior roll cage visible through the windows. Number 5 is prominently displayed on the door, underscoring its competitive purpose. The dry, open track and clear weather conditions highlight the car’s dynamic stance and aerodynamic enhancements.
